custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C839445 PART A in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839445-A in Part Number, pick any category under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, type 1 in the Quantity of the bin row, then click Save.
  • Create a purchase order for this test, purchase order 1, from any vendor, with a line for part A picked from the lookup, 1 ordered and fully received on a vendor invoice.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Purchase Orders in the left menu, then New PO; pick any Vendor, type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839445-A in Part Number and pick part A from the list, type 1 in Quantity, click Add, then click Save & Close. Do not click Receive. On the Purchase Orders list click Receive on that purchase order's row; type any number in Vendor Invoice #, pick an Invoice Date, type 1 in Qty received, then click the Receive Parts button.
  • Use a new part number that no part and no Part Library entry has yet, and that does not contain part A's number.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
